name: s81pq_ix_rb_native
structural_change: r4 (10-16 PQN): route r2spread-bae71e011 TT +21.81 / FF hold -19.51 ps on 12 input->pin-flop endpoints (all 294 data inputs already HB2-padded; reg->reg +19.46, outputs +8.55): the pin-flop row spans the 142-um S face, so the tree leaf spread is 83-84 ps whatever the entry (r3 trial with clk at the S centre 7ae34de8a: insertion 137-220 ps but spread 83.4 and gate hold estimate -18.8 ps, rejected). Fix: input hold stage HB4 pads (strong) on every data input; clk stays at W centre (no extra die pin change); setup in->reg +57-65 ps absorbs the pad; native capture still enforced by io_budget in 0.6. | r2 (10-16 S-ELEM-PQ/PQN): wv1/g1 CLOSED view native capture FAIL 240.9 ps on 224 pins (ba_inc[1] worst; R 142.4, spread 17.1, launch 177.4 PASS): the 16 x 16-bit rounding incrementers (ot_v41_inc) sat between the ba_hi/ba_inc pins and bw_d, and recipe 2 never anchored pin flops (own POST_TAPCELL hook disabled the io_flop_at_pins default). RTL: ba_hi/ba_inc land in plain capture flops hi_c/inc_c on the former bw_d edge and the incrementer moves onto the flop -> SRAM wd/parity path (same value, same edge, 0 cycles, bit-exact). Kit: io_budget in 0.6 / out 0.57 T (route + sign-off enforce the native 190/220 ps pin budgets), recipe 3 (pin_regs wrapper opted out with reason), io_flop_at_pins cols 4 + inhold HB2 + pin_reg_split; outline 142.56 x 86.4, macro and pin FACES unchanged; pins re-spread evenly over each face (spread_face_pins.py: gate r2pin-39e8e45d2 LOOK showed all 528 S pins in one ~25 um segment at 10.5 pins/um with a red hotspot and an empty E half; clk W centre). Util 41% is the macro-bound minimum of the slot (SRAM 94.8 x 41.1 + 20 um channels). | Native57clock PQ: one original SRAM bank per physical read leaf, own original rounding, metadata, parity/written state, selector and final captured32bits. No parent mux/register, no new logical cycle,44SRAM unchanged. Replaces two-SRAM group failing actual100.1ps spread; new CTS and routed parent joins owed. Local real SRAM east M3/M5 via escape keepout .144in/.288out forces pin exits on M4 before via; repairs actual3macro-edgeDRC, no layer/gate waiver.

slot_change_request.name: S-ELEM-PQ-PQN-ixrb-r2
slot_change_request.why: same outline and faces; S-face ba_hi/ba_inc/bt_d and W-face control pins re-spread evenly over the full face (was one 25-um S segment, 10.5 pins/um, density hotspot); die re-pins the 32 ix_rb instances' S/W pin offsets

job.purpose: Native one-SRAM IX bank leaf (x32 per die): pin-captured ba_hi/ba_inc, native capture fix

reroute_reason.fix: input pin capture flops (incrementer moved behind the flop, 0 cycles) + io_flop_at_pins anchoring; RTL change bit-exact (pq_native_core_bench exact PASS, IX/WV mutants FAIL)

pin_regs.reason: RTL already registers every data pin at a dedicated flop, 0 added cycles: inputs ba_hi/ba_inc -> hi_c/inc_c (r2), ba_blk/ba_wv/consume -> write_blk/write_valid/consume_1, h_hi/hw_low/hw_gate -> kreg p1; outputs bt_d = selected flops, bank_fault = sticky flop. A wrapper flop would add +1 write and +1 read edge to the fixed IX/QB/CTL alignment (qb_align) for no gain; io_flop_at_pins anchors the RTL pin flops at the S/W faces.
